steps.label: Liveness check
DFSPH at default scale
Resting 3x3x3 block, y in [8,12]
Container walls
Zero gravity
Rebuild fluid (zero gravity)
Precondition: block starts at y in [8,12]
Run under zero gravity (~1s)
Change (negative control): with zero gravity, the block does not fall -- min Y stays where it started
Restore default downward gravity
Rebuild fluid (gravity restored, same initial block)
Precondition: block starts at y in [8,12] again
Run under normal gravity, same duration (~1s)
Change: with gravity restored, the block actually falls
Invariant: stays inside the container (upper bound)
Invariant: stays inside the container (lower bound)
SetFluidTimeStep is exposed and accepted (no scenario had exercised it as a live knob rather than an incidental setup step before this)
Rebuild fluid with the larger time step
Particle count still sane with the new time step
A few steps at the larger time step run without erroring
